questions.en: What aviation role was the Turkish woman Sabiha Gökçen the first in the world to hold?
questions.answerEn: the world's first female fighter pilot

timeline.labelEn: Sabiha Gökçen, Turkish aviator, the world's first female fighter pilot
timeline.labelDe: Sabiha Gökçen, türkische Fliegerin, erste Kampfpilotin der Welt

questions.cardDe: Was ist meist das Hauptpigment in weißer Farbe?
questions.de: Was ist meist das Hauptpigment in weißer Farbe?
questions.en: What is usually the main pigment in white paint?

timeline.labelEn: Titanium dioxide white pigment produced commercially as Kronos Titan White
timeline.labelDe: Titandioxid-Weißpigment wird als Kronos Titan White kommerziell hergestellt

questions.notes: de.wikipedia: lightfast and cheap, 'daher das bedeutendste Weißpigment'. Historically lead white and zinc white were also used.

questions.cardDe: Bernstein ist brennbar. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Bernstein ist brennbar. Von welchem mittelniederdeutschen Verb leitet sich deshalb sein Name ab?
questions.en: Amber is combustible. Which Middle Low German verb is its German name, Bernstein, therefore derived from?

timeline.labelEn: Baltic amber deposits (Blue Earth) laid down in the late Eocene
timeline.labelDe: Ablagerung des Baltischen Bernsteins (Blaue Erde) im Obereozän

questions.notes: Card statement is true (amber burns easily with a yellow, sooty flame). de.wikipedia: Bernstein from Middle Low German bern(e)stein, 'von bernen „brennen“', after its striking combustibility. Timeline: the amber-bearing sediment is about 35 million years old.

questions.cardDe: Was ist keine Disziplin bei den traditionellen schottischen Highland Games: Baumstamm-, Heuballen- oder Whiskyfässerwerfen?
questions.de: Wie heißt die traditionelle Disziplin der schottischen Highland Games, bei der ein langer, sich verjüngender Baumstamm geworfen wird?
questions.en: What is the traditional Scottish Highland Games event in which a long tapered log is thrown called?

timeline.labelEn: Modern Highland games largely take shape in the 19th century
timeline.labelDe: Die modernen Highland Games entstehen größtenteils im 19. Jahrhundert

questions.notes: Card asks which is NOT a discipline (options: log, hay bale, whisky barrel); reworked to the positive fact because the card's answer is ambiguous — Highland games include a sheaf toss (straw bundle) and a keg toss (half-barrel beer keg), per en.wikipedia Highland games, which is also the timeline source.
